g.text: 按指示连接绿/黄 150 毫米电缆
Attach the Green/Yellow 150mm cable as indicated

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'4',"0421_Black 150mm cable (4.8 terminal plug to free wire)")
ShowToolTip(evt,'5',"0420_Red 150mm cable (4.8 terminal plug to free wire)")
ShowToolTip(evt,'6',"0422_Green/Yellow 150mm cable (4.8 terminal plug to free wire)")
ShowToolTip(evt,'7',"0418_Red 95mm cable 4.8 terminal plug to 4.8 terminal plug")
ShowToolTip(evt,'8',"0419_Black 95mm cable 4.8 terminal plug to 4.8 terminal plug")
